footer_privacy: Your data stays on this server. No requests leave it.
footer_affiliation: Independent open-source project, not affiliated with DKB AG.
error_database_body: Check that Postgres is running and that DATABASE_URL points to it, then reload this page.
empty_title: Start with your first CSV export
empty_body: dkb-dash reads the CSV export of your DKB Girokonto. Nothing is sent anywhere: the file is read on this server and stored in your own database.
statement_reconciled_detail: Matches the bank's balance of {amount} on {date}.
statement_mismatch_detail: The bank reported {bank} on {date}, the transactions here add up to {derived}. A difference of {difference} usually means transactions are missing between two imports.
statement_derived_detail: Derived from the bank's balance on {date}.
imported_banner_skipped: {skipped} were already here and were skipped.
imported_banner_nothing: No new transactions in {file}; the bank balance was recorded.
import_intro: Use the CSV export of your DKB Girokonto. You'll see what changes before anything is saved.
import_drop: Drop the file here or choose it
import_howto_1: Sign in to DKB online banking and open your Girokonto.
import_howto_2: Open the list of transactions and pick the period you want.
import_howto_3: Export the list as CSV and choose the file here.
import_howto_overlap: Overlapping periods are fine: transactions you've already imported are recognised and skipped.
import_error_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB. A DKB export is usually far smaller; check you picked the right file.
import_error_not_text: This doesn't look like a CSV file. Choose the CSV export from DKB online banking.
import_error_no_account_line: The first line should name the account and its IBAN, but it doesn't. Export the file again from your Girokonto.
import_error_no_balance_line: The line with the bank balance ("Kontostand vom …") is missing or unreadable.
import_error_unknown_layout: This isn't the Girokonto export layout dkb-dash knows. Missing columns: {columns}.
review_pending_note: Not imported. They'll come in with a later export once the bank has booked them.
review_new_account: This file belongs to an account that isn't here yet ({iban}). Importing adds it as another account.
review_encoding: The file was read as Windows-1252 (an older export format).
review_nothing_new: Nothing new in this file. Importing still records the bank balance, which keeps the figures reconciled.
review_missing_body: Previews are kept for a day. Choose the file again to see what it contains.
review_duplicates_note: These match transactions already stored and will be skipped.
